Resolves #20035

🌿 *The guard can no longer call a finished leg unfinished because the view it read was a few seconds behind.*

`fetchAnalyzeJobLogs` re-reads the run's jobs endpoint on the existing backoff seams while any Analyze leg is still reported as not `completed`, and only an exhausted wait throws, naming the leg, its last status, the number of reads and the elapsed window; the log fetch then runs as before. Every leg observed on any read stays on the roster until it completes and its log is read, so a later listing that omits a pending leg never shrinks what must be certified (Emmy's RA-1, 8205ab9935). The default `retryDelays` grow to `[1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 32000]` (63 s per phase) so the default covers the 29 s lag measured this morning with margin. The fail-closed contract is unchanged: an unread leg never certifies. Diagnosis, timings and the three rerun receipts are on the ticket.

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright unit run of the guard spec, red-first against the `dev` guard; the patched guard run locally against today's real run 39916733521, read-only, exit 0) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #20022.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-codeql-extraction.spec.mjs` › "a leg the jobs view still reports in_progress is re-read after the backoff and certifies once completed (#20035)"; red on `dev` 3317a124d9 (receipt below) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same file › "a leg that never completes within the backoff stays fail-closed, names it, and never fetches its log (#20035)": rejects with `… is in_progress, not completed, after 3 reads over 15ms`, sleeps `[5, 10]`, no log fetch |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the four #16075 arms unchanged; 22 of 22 in the file (the three roster arms added at 8205ab9935: omitted leg reappearing, omitted leg exhausting, both-completed control) |
| AC-4 | `fetchAnalyzeJobLogs` docblock states the default and the 63 s per-phase bound |
| AC-5 | Post-merge, cut-side: recorded on #20022 once this is on `dev` before the release PR opens |

## Deltas from ticket
- One `retryDelays` bound serves both phases instead of a second option: the two waits are the same race on two endpoints, and one knob keeps the seams the #16075 arms already drive.
- The spec's "an incomplete Analyze leg is terminal" arm is replaced rather than kept: it pinned the premise this PR falsifies.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: with the guard reverted to `dev` (stash of the source file) and the new arms in place, the spec file fails exactly the two new arms (17 passed, 2 failed, both `Analyze leg "Analyze (javascript)" is in_progress, not completed`); with the fix, 19 passed.
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/` as a whole: 826 passed; 5 `templateBuildProcessor.spec.mjs` arms report "did not run", untouched by this PR.
- The patched guard against today's real run: `GITHUB_REPOSITORY=neomjs/neo GITHUB_RUN_ID=39916733521 GITHUB_TOKEN=<read-only> node buildScripts/util/check-codeql-extraction.mjs` → `✅ CodeQL extraction clean — no files dropped across 1 Analyze leg(s).`, exit 0; the same run's first guard attempt failed at 07:19:46Z.
